question: How many unique sessions visited the /regist/input page and then the /regist/confirm page, in that order?
sql:
WITH input_sessions AS (
  SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_input_stamp
  FROM form_log
  WHERE path = '/regist/input'
  GROUP BY session
),
confirm_sessions AS (
  SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_confirm_stamp
  FROM form_log
  WHERE path = '/regist/confirm'
  GROUP BY session
)
SELECT 
  i.session,
  i.first_input_stamp,
  c.first_confirm_stamp
FROM input_sessions i
JOIN confirm_sessions c ON i.session = c.session
WHERE i.first_input_stamp < c.first_confirm_stamp
